description: Opinionated Plugins for Claude Code & Antigravity
name: virajp-plugins

plugins.description: Behavioral guidelines to reduce common LLM coding mistakes, derived from Andrej Karpathy's observations — Think Before Coding, Simplicity First, Surgical Changes, Goal-Driven Execution. External; opt-in (not installed by --all).
plugins.name: andrej-karpathy-skills

plugins.description: Claude Design MCP server plus the vwf design-adapter skills (import-screens, import-design-system) — connects the agent to claude.ai/design (https://api.anthropic.com/v1/design/mcp).
plugins.name: claude-design

plugins.description: Context7 MCP docs server — fetches current, version-accurate documentation for libraries, frameworks, SDKs, and CLIs on demand, so code is never written from stale training knowledge.
plugins.name: context7

plugins.description: Opinionated Flutter plugin — a `dart` router skill (lean SKILL.md routing to on-demand references: GetX, a Firebase suite of auth/analytics/app-check/crashlytics/messaging/storage, and feature areas of architecture, state, navigation, theming, layouts, animations, performance, maps, webview, webrtc, revenuecat, image handling, http/json, concurrency, caching, testing, flavors, app-size, coverage, build) and a `swift` router skill (Swift, SwiftUI, Xcode), plus `kotlin`, `pubspec`, `analysis-options`, and `internationalization`, and bundled Dart, Kotlin & Swift (SourceKit) language servers. Self-contained — no cross-marketplace dependencies.
plugins.name: flutter

plugins.description: Google Cloud stack plugin for vwf — the judgment layer an SDK reference cannot give you: which service to pick and when it stops being the answer, how each one bills and the traps that multiply it, which services have local emulators (and where they lie), and least-privilege IAM shapes. Covers the full Firebase suite plus Cloud SQL, AlloyDB, Memorystore, Bigtable, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Cloud Tasks, Scheduler, Eventarc, Workflows, Cloud Storage, Cloud Run, GKE, Artifact Registry, Cloud Deploy, Cloud Armor, VPC, DNS, Load Balancing, CDN, KMS, Backup & DR, reCAPTCHA Enterprise and Vertex AI. Observability is OpenTelemetry only — GCP services appear as OTLP sinks, never as vendor SDKs. Implements the vwf stack-adapter contract.
plugins.name: gcp

plugins.description: Generate GitHub Actions workflows that install every tool through jdx/mise-action (mise only) and support both polyrepo and monorepo layouts — via the /github-actions:workflow skill.
plugins.name: github-actions

plugins.description: vwf design adapter for Lovable — imports screens and the published .lovable/design-system.json via Lovable's MCP server.
plugins.name: lovable

plugins.description: Opinionated Markdown & documentation standards — writing style, CHANGELOGs, and mermaid diagrams — that auto-apply to every Markdown file, plus a /markdown:readme skill that scans the repo and writes/updates its README.
plugins.name: markdown

plugins.description: AI memory system — mine projects and conversations into a searchable palace. 33 MCP tools, auto-save hooks, guided setup.
plugins.name: mempalace

plugins.description: Opinionated mise plugin — the .config/ three-file split (mise.toml / mise.dev.toml / mise.ci.toml) selected by MISE_ENV, tool/env placement, file-based tasks, and the CI node-gpg workaround. Skill auto-applies to mise configs; /mise:scaffold sets up a repo.
plugins.name: mise

plugins.description: vwf design adapter for Google Stitch — imports generated screens and derives design tokens via @google/stitch-sdk.
plugins.name: stitch

plugins.description: Opinionated TypeScript plugin where Effect is the house standard — a `typescript` router skill (lean SKILL.md routing to on-demand references: Effect-TS patterns, Effect runtime & layers, Vitest testing, the build pipeline for single-package and monorepo) plus `package-json`, `pnpm`, `tsconfig`, and `lint-format`, and the TypeScript/JavaScript language server.
plugins.name: typescript

plugins.description: Highly opinionated Product → Blueprint → Plan → Execute workflow for solo developers or small teams — enforced workspace structure with a selectable stack-template menu checked by /vwf:doctor, a flow-first blueprint (entities as data contracts, OpenAPI + JSON-Schema artifacts) with whole-product coherence review, chained dependency plans, an autonomous execute with review/security/acceptance/UX subagents behind one final merge gate that stamps blueprint implementation state, post-deploy verify with production release freezing + API backward-compat enforcement, feedback intake, and mempalace-backed memory.
plugins.name: vwf
